leads.title: AB v Western Australia - High Court of Australia (2012)
leads.documents: Overturned WA requirement for sterilisation before legal change of sex; ruled two transgender men with mastectomies and hormone treatment could obtain gender recognition certificate.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 2012 case of AB v Western Australia; no URL visible in article text

leads.title: Births, Deaths, Marriages Registration Amendment (Sex or Gender Changes) Act 2024
leads.documents: Abolishes WA Gender Reassignment Board; allows male, female, indeterminate/intersex and nonbinary on birth certificate with appropriate clinical treatment sign-off once a year, no surgery required.
leads.detail: Passed both chambers September 2024, royal assent 26 September 2024, went into effect 30 May 2025; $195 non-refundable fee per WA BDM website

leads.title: Gender Reassignment Act 2000 / WA Gender Reassignment Board
leads.documents: Prior WA rights machinery for legal gender change; classified transgender protections as 'Gender History' and required unmarried status until 2019 reform.
leads.detail: Cited via Gender Reassignment Act 2000 and repeal requirement unmarried provision passed lower house 20 Nov 2018, upper house 12 Feb 2019, assent 19 Feb 2019, commenced 19 March 2019

leads.title: Equal Opportunity Act 1984 (WA) - as amended 2002
leads.documents: WA anti-discrimination machinery; sexual orientation added 2002, transgender covered only as Gender History; 2022 proposal to add gender identity and sex characteristics and repeal religious schools exemption.
leads.detail: Cited as Equal Opportunity Act 1984 amended by Acts Amendment (Gay and Lesbian Law Reform) Act 2002; review announced Oct 2018, reform deferred past March 2025 election

leads.title: Sex Discrimination Amendment (Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity and Intersex Status) Act 2013 (Cth)
leads.documents: Federal protection for LGBT and intersex people in WA cited as overlay to limited state protections.
leads.detail: Cited by full Act title 2013; also cited as basis for mid-August 2026 WA Supreme Court and Court of Appeals surrogacy ruling under s109 Constitution

leads.title: Law Reform (Decriminalisation of Sodomy) Act 1989
leads.documents: Decriminalised private same-sex acts effective 23 March 1990 but set unequal age of consent 21 vs 16 and created promotion offences for schools/public policy.
leads.detail: Passed Dec 1989, effective 23 March 1990; repealed in part by 2002 reforms

leads.title: Acts Amendment (Gay and Lesbian Law Reform) Act 2002
leads.documents: Equalised consent at 16, repealed promotion bans, added sexual orientation to Equal Opportunity Act, enabled same-sex adoption and lesbian parentage and Family Court jurisdiction.
leads.detail: Introduced by Attorney-General Jim McGinty and Greens Leader Giz Watson; made WA first state for full same-sex adoption

leads.title: Historical Homosexual Convictions Expungement Bill 2017 / Act 2018
leads.documents: Scheme to expunge historical homosexual convictions with mandatory test, including applications by family of deceased; accompanied by Premier Mark McGowan formal apology.
leads.detail: Introduced 1 Nov 2017, passed Assembly 22 Feb 2018, Council 23 Aug 2018, assent 18 Sept 2018, effective 15 Oct 2018; Law Society of WA proposal April 2016 cited as precursor

leads.title: Western Australia transgender prisoner housing policy - reported November 2020
leads.documents: Enforcement practice: transgender prisoners can be housed according to gender identity for health and safety reasons if no sexual offences on record.
leads.detail: Cited as November 2020 reporting of recently implemented policies; no outlet/URL visible in text

leads.title: Western Australia Supreme Court custody ruling - October 2021
leads.documents: Documented enforcement incident: family lost custody by court order for continuing abuse of transgender child, described as Australian legal first precedent.
leads.detail: Cited as October 2021 WA Supreme Court order; related April 2021 suicide of 15-year-old transgender teenager in Perth cited as prompting reform calls
